move_tensors_to_cuda: move a nested sample of PyTorch tensors from CPU to a specified CUDA device
move_tensors_to_cpu: move a nested sample of PyTorch tensors from GPU to CPU with optional fp32 casting
clip_grad_norm: clip gradient norms of model parameters using l2 or inf norm with distributed all-reduce support
make_positions: replace non-padding symbols in a tensor with their sequential position numbers starting after padding index
extract_hard_alignment: extract hard token-to-token alignment pairs from attention weights between source and target sentences
